capabilities: Encrypt individual values into inline ciphertext tokens via a modal
Unlock and lock a note with a per-note master password
Copy mixed selections of text and secrets as fully decrypted plaintext
Edit and re-encrypt existing secrets in place
Block any copy operation that touches locked secrets
disambiguation: Not a whole-note or vault encryption tool; only the chosen inline values are encrypted, the rest of the file remains readable plaintext.
extras: Unreviewed by Obsidian staff. README carries strong warnings: cryptography is unaudited, there is no password recovery, and it documents exposure windows from sync providers, File Recovery snapshots, undo history and clipboard managers.
problem: Notes are plaintext files that autosave, sync and File Recovery can capture, so secrets typed into a note body can leak to disk or cloud storage before being protected.
summary: Inline encryption plugin that stores chosen values in a note as ciphertext tokens while the rest of the note stays plain Markdown.
